coordinate_system: Same datum as HW1: lower-left outside corner of the floor envelope; +x right, +y up; metres

A.description: Left vertical perimeter beam, one-sided slab support

B.description: Horizontal beam on the C1-C2-C3 line, interior/two-sided slab support

loads.load_basis: Unfactored service load; beam self-weight excluded because HW2 asks for slab-to-beam transfer and the plan gives no beam density/load instruction

materials_and_sections.note: Beam depth is not printed on Floor Plan 1; 300x600 mm is an explicit modelling assumption used consistently in both compared models. Plan column sizes govern where marked 400x400.

analysis.tie_break: Stable beam ID order; ties occupy zero theoretical area and only affect raster-boundary cells
